firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently went up a tower starts and receives two white bricks.
clarifications: Proceeding clockwise, each later player receives one more white brick than the preceding player.
Regular turns start with that player and proceed clockwise.
This is Quined Games’ 2018 reprint of the original 2010 design.
